description: This source file defines the `ConceptReferenceRange` class in the OpenMRS API project, representing a database entity that specifies acceptable numeric reference ranges for concepts, including criteria such as age and gender. It includes JPA/Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping, getter/setter methods, and minimal logic.
